svg.title: Tremor Scroll: Seismograph drum
svg.desc: Tremor Scroll (1D): the scholars' record as a smoked-paper drum, one scratched line per day read left to right through dawn, noon and dusk. In winter the tremors come only at noon on sun days, and every seventh day a faint ripple runs at noon on every face at once. The last three lines are still blank smoke, and the player has pencilled their forecast in gold: a ripple on day fourteen.
svg.text: FORECAST: 12 none · 13 noon, south, 1 · 14 the ripple, every face
